verifications.claim: PlayStation Network (PSN) experienced an outage on March 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'PlayStation Network services were impacted on Saturday'; R2: 'trouble began at 4:59pm on 21 March'; R4: 'starting from the 21st of March, 4:16 PM ET'; R5: timestamps 'March 21, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm PSN outage on March 21, 2026.

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected PS4/PS5 gaming.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'impacted PS4 and PS5'; R2: 'online play on both PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4'; R4: 'PS5, PS4'; R5: 'Gaming & Social'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state impact on PS4/PS5 gaming and online play.

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected social features.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Gaming & Social'; R2: 'Gaming & Social — the backbone of online play'; R4: 'friends list etc.'; R5: 'Gaming & Social'

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected store access.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Official outage lists (Gaming & Social, specific features like Tournaments) do not mention PlayStation Store; R5 notes downloads worked during outage.

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected launching games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'difficulty launching games, apps, or network features'; R2: 'You might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from official status page confirms impact on launching games.

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected app usage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'difficulty launching games, apps, or network features'; R2: 'You might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from official status page confirms impact on launching apps.

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected tournaments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'services hit would include “Challenges, Game Help, Game Streaming, Tournaments, Trophies.”'

verifications.claim: The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected trophies.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'services hit would include “Challenges, Game Help, Game Streaming, Tournaments, Trophies.”'; R5: 'I can see my Trophies again!'
verifications.reasoning: Official list explicitly includes Trophies; user reports confirm impact.

verifications.claim: Reports of the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage initially peaked over 14,000.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'at the peak the number was over 14,000'; R4: 'peak on Downdetector was 50,000+ reports'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on peak reports (14,000+ vs. 50,000+).

verifications.claim: Reports of the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage are decreasing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sharp fall in the number of people facing issues'; R4: 'trends on Downdetector indicate a sharp decline'; R5: 'outage graphs continue to fall'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Downdetector reports falling.

verifications.claim: The official PlayStation Network status shows improvement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'PlayStation provided an update on their status'; R2: 'status page has since been updated to indicate that all services are back online'; R4: 'All services online'; R5: 'Status page now says all services are online'
verifications.reasoning: Official status page updated to show services resolved/online.

verifications.claim: No official reason has been disclosed for the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network service disruption.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The cause for the services getting affected has not yet been disclosed'; R4: 'Sony has yet to issue the reason behind this PSN Server outage'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state no cause disclosed by Sony.
